page.overview:
Who is Colonel Candy Corn?

Colonel Candy Corn's body is like a conjoined piece of candy corn. A large piece turned upside down is his body, and at the edge of that facing upwards is the candy corn that is his face. He has a gray, hairy mustache, as well as hair at the side of his head indicating he is bald. He is a bit bumpy and wears a medal. He also walks with a cane.

Linda is the unseen former spouse of Colonel Candy Corn first mentioned in "Something Big." It was in this episode that the Colonel mentions his life hasn't been the same since she has passed away. This indicates that the Colonel may be suffering from Prolonged Grief Disorder, a condition commonly experienced in widowers. This same condition was also observed in Cherry Cream Soda in the eponymous episode.
